Comments: Male pin headers soldered into the Raspberry Pi Pico
Female pin headers used to mount the Raspberry Pi Pico into the motherboard.

This stackable pin socket goes between the pin header of the controboard and the pin socket of the motherboard. Must be stackable e.g. have long pins. Exact pin length is unimportant as they will be cut down. See build instructions.
This goes between the bottomboard and motherboard. If you can find a non-threaded M3 spacer that’s 3mm tall, it may be preferred. This nylon hex nut is fine, see build guide for more details.
You choose the size. I used 10mm wide.
